rationale: This mutation resolves the $9,083 cash deficit by expanding the land ceiling to 20-24 contiguous plots across three synchronized early waves (8-10 plots by Day 4-5 with 3-4 hands; 14-16 plots by Day 7-8 with 6-8 hands; 20-24 plots by Day 10-12 with 10-11 hands) to reach an optimal ~2.1 plots/hand ratio without late-game overspending. It elevates shed drop-offs to trigger immediately post-harvest (ahead of plot watering and replanting) to unlock continuous midday capital velocity, while lowering early batch liquidations (>=2 surplus on Days 1-5) and setting dynamic mid-game floors (>=0.85x base, relaxing to 0.78x only when shed fullness >= 50% or glut risk >= 0.48) to avoid order-book slippage. Finally, it gates Town Shop seed procurement behind vacant or expanding land while aggressively fulfilling shop contracts from existing shed inventory, integrates a Day 22-26 Carrot backfill for vacant plots, and executes terminal clearance starting at Step 680 down to 0.65x base price.
